tally.citation: The AC requires the prompt evals to pass on the 5.5 models and the epic moves prompt-eval spec pins to 5.5 ids, but the bug shows seven plan-review specs failing schema validation on the 5.5 run, against the REVIEW_RESULT shape the epic's verdict adapter must emit.
tally.title: Prompt evals: plan-review criterion specs fail with "'dimension' is a required property" schema error

tally.citation: Epic AC requires 'the provider-parity and prompt evals pass on the new models' and its child ticket moves 'prompt-eval spec model pins to the 5.5 ids'; the three named specs (plan-review-container/-finder/-isf-finder) score 0.00 in the live `eval-live` loop, so the before/after prompt-eval deliverable cannot be shown to pass.
tally.title: Live prompt-eval loop has no solver for plan-review-container, -finder and -isf-finder specs (coverage 0.00)

tally.citation: The bug is in the pre-existing provider_parity harness tracker resolution (gate_source.gate_read_root in src/rebar/llm/evals/provider_parity.py:355), adjacent to the epic's model-upgrade eval step but not something the epic changed or claimed to fix.
tally.title: provider_parity harness fails in a fresh worktree until a CLI call attaches .tickets-tracker

tally.citation: The bug is in the Bedrock spend-cap Lambda's metered ceiling estimate (infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap), which is adjacent to the epic's 5.5 model-id and alarm work but not a deliverable the epic claimed; the 5.5-profile cause is only an unproven hypothesis.
tally.title: Bedrock spend-cap metered estimate ran about 3x settled billing on 2026-11-12, above the README's documented band

tally.citation: Mismatch: the bug concerns release tagging in docs/releasing.md and release.yml's github_release job, but the epic deliverables are the plan-review engine switch, agentic engine, verdict adapter, attestation provenance and the 5.5 model upgrade; no AC or child ticket touches release tags.
tally.title: docs/releasing.md says release tags are annotated, but release.yml creates lightweight tags (v0.13.1, v0.14.0, v0.15.0)
